newsitem.title: USA: Interstate to omit qtly cash distribution.
newsitem.headline: Interstate to omit qtly cash distribution.

text.p: Interstate General Company L.P., a diversified real estate organization, said Thursday the board of its managing general partner had voted not to pay a quarterly cash distribution for the three months ended September 30.

The board determined two previous distributions in 1996 totaling $0.11 per unit were sufficient to cover the company's mandatory distribution of 55 percent of net taxable earnings each year, Interstate said.
The company said earlier Thursday that it planned to restructure the partnership to boost unit holder value, including its conversion into a real estate investment trust.
